body.statement: For a fixed finite vector \(Q=(C_1(p),\ldots,C_d(p))\) returned by \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{r,i}\varphi_r(X_{ri})+o_P(1)\) and converges to \(N(0,\Sigma_Q)\). The plug-in covariance is consistent, and the rank-aware Gaussian max-statistic region has asymptotic simultaneous coverage \(1-\alpha\) for all positive-variance coordinates. Symbolically constant cells are exact equalities; zero estimated variance without symbolic constancy is reported as degenerate rather than studentized.
body.justification: Symbolic identification becomes statistically usable when its multi-regime derivatives and degenerate cells are handled automatically.
body.gap: LiLuedtke2023 derives influence functions for prespecified smooth data-fusion targets, while Tikka2023 returns symbolic acyclic counterfactual formulas without an inference compiler.
body.consumer: cfid can return estimates, influence functions, joint covariance, and simultaneous regions beside every regular circuit.
